title: Multi-file patch hunk grammar guard
failure_signature: A multi-file apply_patch payload inserted a new file header before closing the preceding update hunk and was rejected before mutation.
trigger_preconditions: A hunk boundary is followed immediately by another file header without valid context.
candidate_workaround: Use one syntactically complete update hunk per file and validate each file header boundary before submitting the patch.
recurrence_guard: Do not leave a bare hunk marker before the next file header; prefer smaller multi-file patches when contexts differ.
rollback: No rollback is required because patch parsing failed before mutation.
scope_boundary: Patch grammar only; no repository content changed in the failed witness.
